itens.titulo: Vale não prevê dividendos extraordinários em 2026, diz CFO
itens.descricao: Vale não prevê dividendos extraordinários em 2026, diz CFO CNN Brasil
trechos: A Vale não prevê o pagamento de dividendos extraordinários em 2026, diante das incertezas geopolíticas esperadas para o próximo ano.

A informação foi dada nesta sexta-feira (30) pelo vice-presidente executivo de Finanças e Relações com Investidores da companhia, Marcelo Bacci, durante teleconferência sobre os resultados do terceiro trimestre.
"Preferimos ficar do lado conservador para lidarmos com as medidas incertas", afirmou Bacci.
A Vale mantém em aberto um programa de recompra de até 100 milhões de ações, aprovado pelo Conselho de Administração em julho deste ano.
"Temos um programa de recompra em aberto, para recomprar até 100 milhões de ações.
Isso dá oportunidade para recomprar", disse.
"Vamos continuar monitorando o mercado.
Achamos que vamos ter oportunidades nos próximos meses de fazer recompras", concluiu.

itens.titulo: Google lost nearly half a trillion this week. Here's how Mike Khouw is trading it
itens.descricao: Google lost nearly half a trillion this week. Here's how Mike Khouw is trading it CNBC
trechos: "Be fearful when others are greedy, and greedy when others are fearful," said the great Warren Buffett is his classic Berkshire Hathaway shareholder letter in 1986.
Alphabet's (GOOGL) Q3 2026 earnings report triggered a historic gap down; the stock fell over 12% to $285, shaving nearly $500 billion in market cap.

Despite a 103% surge in Cloud revenue that points to underlying fundamental strength, the market focused on the EPS miss ($2.12 vs. $3.02 estimate) and negative free cash flow (AI capital expenditures are relentless!).
Historically, stocks that absorb a wave of downgrades underperform or trade sideways over the next 30 days as institutional repositioning caps upside momentum.
(Fodder for another article, but this is one of the most predictive "factors to watch") Second, the technical posture is severely damaged.
With the RSI plunging into the low 20s and the MACD accelerating its sell signal, the technical overhead is heavy.
However, extreme oversold conditions at the bottom of the 52-week range ($270.70) should stem a total freefall.
Strategy Setup: To exploit this anticipated 30-day chop, a short strangle lets traders collect premium while leaving room for consolidation.

itens.titulo: Intel: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
itens.descricao: Intel: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors Yahoo Finance
trechos: On its Q3 2026 earnings call, held on Oct.
29, 2026, Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) announced $16.5 billion in revenue, driven by growth in its Data Center and AI division.
By our estimates, server CPU TAM, largely driven by agentic workloads, could increase as much as 5x from where it is today, from $40 billion to more than $200 billion over 5 years.
Management projects unit volume declines through 2026 until industrywide component supply normalizes.
We expect the 2026 PC unit TAM to decline approximately 12%, with second half units down more than 20%.
These operational gains helped expand gross margin, which measures the percentage of revenue remaining after production expenses, by 2 percentage points sequentially.
Intel 3 costs improved approximately 15% from Q1 levels, while volumes increased in the mid-teens sequentially.
Intel 18A costs have declined approximately 40% since Q1, reflecting continued yield and cycle time improvements.
